Major AI Developments.title: CIP Ranchi To Be Upgraded to Regional Apex Institution for Mental Healthcare
Major AI Developments.summary: The Central Institute for Psychiatry (CIP) in Ranchi is to be upgraded into a regional apex institution for mental healthcare. The upgrade, announced in the Union budget, will expand CIP into a 500-bed hospital offering comprehensive services for all age groups. This move aims to improve mental healthcare in eastern India and reduce stigma surrounding mental health.
